dialogues.speaker: Chihu Rock Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Each day the high and low tides come to shore, each splash of the sea different from the last."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I still sit here watching the waves join and part, thinking of you."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When will you return from some vast sea far away and see this message, my heart poured out for you to see?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When will we be able to fulfill our promises, made to each other long ago?"

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Reply
dialogues.text: "Please do not post love letters on the Bulletin Board. Thank you."
